# LifeOS — 3D Evolution Terminal (1982–2026)

> Markdown version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/lifeos>. Author: **Mauricio Yokoyama Issei**. The page is an interactive 3D experience; this text describes what it is and where the text content is.

The life of a Tech Lead counted as a system in production 44 years ago: a gamified 3D portal that uses the metaphors of Git, SRE and Kintsugi. The visitor starts the journey, navigates the arrows and decodes each memory by keeping the button pressed.

The content is visual and generated in the browser. The same trajectory, in text and in scenes, is in [Evolutionary Terminal](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/terminal-evolutivo.md); the structured professional profile is in [Mauricio Yokoyama Issei](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/index.md).
